meta.title: Using icons in a BwB report
meta.tagline: Where icons help, and how to place them in the approved colours

blocks.text: An icon earns its place when it names a topic, marks a callout or labels a tile. Inline icons sit with the text, for example {icon:droplets} water, {icon:banknote} finance and {icon:landmark} institutions, and take the size of the line.

blocks.title: Lesson
blocks.text: Use few icons, and give every one a job. A page of icons is decoration, not signposting.

blocks.title: Caveat
blocks.text: Lime and white never go on a light background. The builder substitutes an approved colour and says so.
A short list of workstreams, each with a title and a sentence, reads well as an icon grid.
